facts.value: Mechanization is providing human operators with machinery that assists them with the muscular requirements of work or displaces muscular work.

facts.value: In modern usage, mechanization implies machinery more complex than hand tools and would not include simple devices such as an un-geared horse or donkey mill.
facts.programme_association: Machine Learning for Finance - MSc (Online) | University of Limerick

facts.value: Devices that cause speed changes or changes to or from reciprocating to rotary motion, using means such as gears, pulleys, sheaves and belts, shafts, cams, and cranks, usually are considered machines.
facts.programme_association: Machine Learning for Finance - MSc (Online) | University of Limerick

facts.value: After electrification, when most small machinery was no longer hand powered, mechanization was synonymous with motorized machines.

facts.value: Automation is the use of control systems and information technologies to reduce the need for human work in the production of goods and services.

facts.value: In the scope of industrialization, automation is a step beyond mechanization.

facts.value: Whereas mechanization provides human operators with machinery to assist them with the muscular requirements of work, automation greatly decreases the need for human sensory and mental requirements as well.
